headline: Maryland man killed in I-78 crash in Hunterdon County
dek: New Jersey State Police said the 21-year-old driver lost control of an Audi and struck the rear corner of a parked tractor-trailer early Sunday in Union Township.
body: A 21-year-old Maryland man was killed early Sunday when the Audi he was driving struck a parked tractor-trailer on Interstate 78 in Hunterdon County, according to New Jersey State Police.

The crash happened around 3:34 a.m. on westbound I-78 near milepost 15.4 in Union Township, News 12 New Jersey reported. Police said the Audi ran off the right side of the highway and hit the rear corner of the tractor-trailer.
The driver was from Riverdale, Maryland. State police had not publicly released his name in the initial report, and the circumstances surrounding why he lost control remained under investigation.

The fatal crash occurred as a powerful nor’easter was affecting New Jersey and other Northeast states, but the initial police account did not identify weather as a cause. No additional fatality was confirmed in the reporting available Sunday.
location: Union Township, Hunterdon County, New Jersey
author: NorthEast News Desk
